title: Modified function formatPrice to take a currency
context: Every price in the shop was formatted in US dollars, and no caller could ask for another currency. The price formatter now takes the currency from its caller. The catalogue and the cart pass the one currency of the store, US dollars, so every price a shopper sees reads as it did before.
- **When** a shopper opens the catalogue or the cart, **then** nothing changes: a price of 1250 cents still shows as `$12.50`.
- **When** a caller formats 1250 cents with the currency `"EUR"`, **then** [the text is `€12.50`](code:src/lib/format.ts#formatPrice). No caller does so in this change.
- Removed the module-level `priceFormatter`, an `Intl.NumberFormat` fixed to `"USD"`.
- Modified [`formatPrice()`](code:src/lib/format.ts#formatPrice) to take a second parameter `currency` and to build its `Intl.NumberFormat` from that currency on each call.
- Modified [the import from `@/lib/format`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartLine.tsx#L2) in `CartLine.tsx` to add `STORE_CURRENCY`.
- Modified [`<CartLine />`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartLine.tsx#CartLine) to pass `STORE_CURRENCY` to `formatPrice()` for the line total.
- Modified [the import from `@/lib/format`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#L3) in `CartSummary.tsx` to add `STORE_CURRENCY`.
- Modified [`<CartSummary />`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#CartSummary) to pass `STORE_CURRENCY` to `formatPrice()` for the cart total.
- Modified [`<ProductCard />`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/ProductCard.tsx#ProductCard) to pass `STORE_CURRENCY` to `formatPrice()` for the product price.

files.title: Price formatting takes the currency as a parameter
summary: Removed the module-level `priceFormatter`, an `Intl.NumberFormat` fixed to `"USD"`.
Modified [`formatPrice()`](code:src/lib/format.ts#formatPrice) to take a second parameter `currency` and to build its `Intl.NumberFormat` from that currency on each call.

waypoints.title: Added the constant `STORE_CURRENCY` for the one currency of the store
waypoints.reading: The author added a constant `STORE_CURRENCY` that holds `"USD"`, the currency the removed `priceFormatter` was fixed to. [`<CartLine />`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartLine.tsx#CartLine), [`<CartSummary />`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#CartSummary) and [`<ProductCard />`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/ProductCard.tsx#ProductCard) each pass it to [`formatPrice()`](code:src/lib/format.ts#formatPrice) as the currency, so that every price on the catalogue and the cart still shows in US dollars.

waypoints.title: Modified `formatPrice()` to take the currency as a parameter
waypoints.reading:
The author modified a function `formatPrice()` that:

- takes a second parameter `currency`, which every caller now has to pass
- builds an `Intl.NumberFormat` for `"en-US"` and that currency on each call, where the module built one formatter fixed to `"USD"` once
- returns the same text as before for `"USD"`: `$12.50` for 1250 cents

[`<CartLine />`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartLine.tsx#CartLine), [`<CartSummary />`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#CartSummary) and [`<ProductCard />`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/ProductCard.tsx#ProductCard) are its three callers. Each passes [`STORE_CURRENCY`](code:src/lib/format.ts#STORE_CURRENCY), so that no price on the catalogue or the cart changes.
waypoints.needsAttention: This is the change the pull request exists for: `formatPrice()` no longer fixes the currency to `"USD"`, and every caller now has to name one. The other waypoints add [`STORE_CURRENCY`](code:src/lib/format.ts#STORE_CURRENCY) and pass it at the three calls.
